description:
Update your marketplace listing in place — name, models, payout address, endpoint, description, price, or accepted token — no delete/re-add. Switching acceptedToken requires a new pricePerRequest in the same call. Signs an update message with the unlocked payout wallet and PATCHes it. Only fields you pass change. Changing the endpoint re-verifies reachability before taking effect. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

acceptedToken.description: New token callers pay in: sBTC or USDCx. Requires pricePerRequest too.

allowUnsafeGateway.description: Allow a gateway host outside localhost / *.aibtc.com. Required to send wallet-signed headers (and any apiKey) to an arbitrary host — leave unset unless you deliberately self-host the gateway.

apiKey.description: Set/replace the key your endpoint requires (locks the endpoint).

endpoint.description: New OpenAI-compatible base URL (re-verified before it takes effect).

gateway.description: Marketplace gateway base URL. Defaults to https://inference.aibtc.com. Use http://localhost:8787 for local dev.

models.description: New Hugging Face repo id list.

payoutAddress.description: New payout address (must match the gateway network).

pricePerRequest.description: Flat price per request, as a whole number in the accepted token's base unit: sats for sBTC ("5" = 5 sats), 0.000001 USDCx for USDCx ("2000" = 0.002 USDCx). No decimals.

providerId.description: The provider id returned at registration (from inference_list_providers).

name: inference_update_provider
